About.label: About me
About.title: Professional profile
About.body: DevOps Engineer with 20 years of experience in Linux systems administration and Open Source software, evolving and learning new technologies in complex projects. Full professional proficiency in English for international projects and services. Specialized in deployment, monitoring and troubleshooting of applications on Openshift Container Platform and Kubernetes.
About.body2: Strong experience creating and scheduling tasks in Red Hat Ansible Tower, planning backups and application migrations, and Bash/Python scripting. Experience deploying resources and infrastructure using IaC (Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, TFE), both on-prem and on public clouds.
